content.short: CryptoPeeps is an original pop art NFT collection powered by the Cardano blockchain.
content.description: CryptoPeeps is an original pop art NFT collection powered by the Cardano blockchain. The artwork source code is stored directly on-chain in the form of 64-byte chunks. Inspired by the likes of CryptoPunks, Spacebudz and Keith Haring, the artist has brought to life an eccentric cohort of pixel peeple to share with the Cardano community. CryptoPeeps stores the artwork file directly on the Cardano blockchain - we do not use IPFS. When you buy a peep, you're being the literal artwork. At any moment in time, you can recreate a brand new file from the token metadata.
content.meta: Find out about Cryptopeeps (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
